criteria.text: Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Calculates the long-stop date as 28 September 2026 (120 days after signing on 31 May 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 12 November 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 28 September 2026, with days remaining from 15 June 2026 (105 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
